summary: The occupation estimate and deterministic alternative follow with the exact original-law objects from the two exchange predecessors. The reference scalar definitions agree with both cited scalar normalizations, and their one-coordinate estimates apply independently to all three cost groups. The finite bounds (11)-(14) correctly give a deterministic exchange cost below 2 for every stated cap. The selected support is exactly the two-cost four-site core with three-site tails, including the binary companions represented by infeasible third sites; its ambient dimension and all original height weights are preserved. Combining the accepted tail coefficient with the fourth-power mass transfer gives exactly (9). Empty deleted tails, zero tilt or cap, zero companions, and equality cases introduce no gap.
